column2: [intro]
I walk this fine line, always in balance,
One step forward, one step back, without any malice.
I risk it all with my wordplay,
Entangling lost hearts, I’m their hero, come what may.
In my life, everything is double-meaning,
I love playing with words and feelings, so freeing.
I offer smiles and mischievous mysteries,
Double, triple, I reign supreme in ambiguity.
I can compliment you while teasing,
A mischievous smile, charming and pleasing.
I hide my intentions behind my laughs,
My disconcerting humor is my craft.
In my songs, there’s always a twist,
I entertain, confuse, and leave you in the mist.
Laughter and tears blend under my verse,
Double, triple, I make the universe dance in reverse.
[ solo ]
So come with me to this bubbling world,
Where words are acrobats, imagination unfurled.
Let yourself be swept by my light and carefree pen,
In this dance of ambiguity, I’m the magician of the den.
[outro]
